_about: First-pass score proposals by Claude, 2026-10-21. Every score still needs human review; these exist so the review has a starting point. Each entry is [value, reason]. Proposals override the wiki value in tags.<scale>.value; the wiki's own scores stay in tags.<scale>.wikiScores. Two rules were applied across the board, recorded per item by the build: (1) evidenceSupport is capped at 3 when the dataset holds no citation for the item, because the score should be backed by something a reader can check; (2) evidenceSupport is never proposed for an unscored item, because that would be inventing evidence. Reach, ease, impact and novelty are judgement calls and are proposed for every advice item.
